name: smwmusic-mario-kart-wii-moonview-highway
title: Mario Kart Wii - Moonview Highway
description:
The groovy theme from arguably one of the most memorable Mario Kart Wii tracks-- maybe because you're getting hit by a Blue Shell, Red Shell, Lightning, Blooper, and Bomb Car for good measure, all in succession.

This port includes both the highway and city versions of the song, one after the other.

Originally ported for Superfamicompo 5, but now has a pitch bend on the @1 lead, which you can remove by blanking out the macro called "sawbend".

Also holy crap there is a lot going on in this song.
